summary_en: This Phase 2 study tests epcoritamab added to standard drugs as consolidation therapy in chronic lymphocytic leukemia (CLL) or small lymphocytic lymphoma (SLL) after a second-generation BTK inhibitor, with or without obinutuzumab. Epcoritamab is given under the skin (subcutaneously), with step-up doses in cycle 1 and then doses on set days through cycles 2 to 12, while the BTK inhibitor is taken by mouth every day during the trial period. The record does not state a main outcome measure; it is listed as a Phase 2 study.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 evalúa epcoritamab añadido a medicamentos estándar como terapia de consolidación en leucemia linfocítica crónica (LLC) o linfoma linfocítico de pequeñas células (LLPC), después de un inhibidor de BTK de segunda generación, con o sin obinutuzumab. Epcoritamab se administra debajo de la piel (subcutánea), con dosis escalonadas en el ciclo 1 y luego dosis en días establecidos durante los ciclos 2 a 12, mientras que el inhibidor de BTK se toma por vía oral todos los días durante el período del estudio. El registro no indica una medida de resultado principal; el estudio figura como de fase 2.
who_for: Diagnosis of CLL or SLL, or a listed variant, after at least 12 months of acalabrutinib or zanubrutinib, with or without obinutuzumab
Partial response or better, but detectable disease in blood or bone marrow by ClonoSEQ
Age 18 or older with ECOG performance status 2 or better
Adequate blood counts, liver and kidney function
Agrees to contraception rules and signs informed consent
not_for: Complete response, or nodal partial response, with no detectable disease by ClonoSEQ
No CD20 expression on CLL cells before treatment
Prior treatment with any CD3xCD20 bispecific antibody
Pregnant or breastfeeding, or currently taking warfarin
